description: Immediately before posting a status comment to claim a task, re-fetch all comments on the thread (issue comments or PR comments depending on source type) and search for any comment matching the pattern <!-- otto:v1 status ... source=<current-comment-type>:<current-comment-id> -->. If one is found, this comment is already claimed — skip it entirely. This re-fetch is the primary race prevention mechanism.
title: Status comment existence check (claim gate)
